name: Create Branches of Government Flipchart
description:
Create a 3-page interactive flipchart lesson on the Three Branches of the US Government.

Structure the flipchart as follows:

1. **Page 1 (Overview)**: Title "Three Branches of Government". Include text introducing the "Legislative", "Executive", and "Judicial" branches.

2. **Page 2 (Details)**: Create distinct sections for each branch. You must include these specific terms: "Congress", "Senate", "House of Representatives" (for Legislative), "President" (for Executive), and "Supreme Court" (for Judicial).

3. **Page 3 (Checks and Balances)**: Title "Checks and Balances". Create a visual diagram using shapes (rectangles/circles) and lines/arrows to connect them. Include at least two specific examples of checks, such as "veto", "impeach", "override", "appoint", or "judicial review".

Save the file to: `/home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/branches_of_government.flipchart`.
